billing.definition: Customer questions or issues related to payments, invoices, charges, refunds, pricing, or subscription costs
examples: My invoice shows the wrong amount
I was charged twice this month
Can I get a refund for last month?
Why did my bill increase?
edge_cases: Upgrade pricing questions → intent là 'upgrade', không phải 'billing'
Cancellation refund request → intent là 'cancellation', không phải 'billing'

technical.definition: Customer reports of bugs, errors, crashes, or any feature not working as expected
examples: The app keeps crashing when I try to login
I'm getting a 500 error on the dashboard
The export feature is broken
Your system is very slow today
edge_cases: API errors → intent là 'api', không phải 'technical'
Login issue do billing/account suspended → intent là 'billing'

cancellation.definition: Customer explicitly requests to cancel, terminate, or not renew their subscription or account
examples: I want to cancel my subscription
Please close my account
I don't want to renew next month
How do I stop being charged?
edge_cases: Hỏi về cancellation policy mà không có ý định cancel → intent là 'billing'
Muốn downgrade plan, không phải cancel → intent là 'upgrade'

upgrade.definition: Customer asks about upgrading, downgrading, or switching their subscription plan, or inquires about premium features
examples: How do I upgrade to the Pro plan?
What features do I get with Enterprise?
I want to switch from monthly to annual
Can I downgrade my plan?
edge_cases: Hỏi giá chung chung → intent là 'billing'
Hỏi về tính năng không liên quan đến plan → intent là 'technical'

complaint.definition: Customer expresses strong dissatisfaction or frustration about service quality without a specific technical or billing issue
examples: Your service is absolutely terrible
I've been waiting 3 days and nobody responded
This is the worst customer support I've ever experienced
I'm extremely frustrated with your company
edge_cases: Complaint kèm vấn đề kỹ thuật cụ thể → intent là 'technical'
Complaint về billing cụ thể → intent là 'billing'
Chỉ complaint thuần túy về trải nghiệm → mới là 'complaint'

api.definition: Developer questions about API usage, rate limits, authentication, endpoints, SDK, webhooks, or integrations
examples: My API key is not working
What is the rate limit for the free tier?
How do I authenticate with OAuth?
The webhook is not firing on my server
edge_cases: General app bug không liên quan đến API → intent là 'technical'
